/-!
# Finite arithmetic certificates for complementary eta coefficients

The localized Gaussian leading coefficient is a positive universal
multiplicity factor times the squared norm of the first nonzero eta moment.
This module bounds its complementary-zero ratio using two eta-arithmetic
estimates which do not invoke completion symmetry:

* a phase-sensitive finite prefix minus its rigorous tail envelope gives a
  lower bound at `rho`; and
* the explicit first-gap envelope gives an upper bound at `1 - conj rho`.

Whenever the finite lower certificate is positive, their squared quotient is
therefore a certified upper bound for the complementary coefficient ratio.
At high ordinate and on the right of the critical line, quantitative
reflection rigidity turns this into an explicit upper bound on horizontal
zero displacement.

The certificate is not asserted to be close to one.  Establishing such a
uniform arithmetic estimate remains conjecture-strength work.
-/

open Complex Filter MeasureTheory Metric Set Topology
open scoped Classical ComplexConjugate ENNReal Interval Topology

namespace RiemannGaussian

noncomputable section

/-- The complementary leading-coefficient ratio is definitionally the square
of the corresponding raw eta-moment norm ratio.  This identity uses neither
the xi functional equation nor the completion multiplier. -/
theorem
    pairedEtaLocalizedGaussianLargeTimeLeadingCoefficient_conjugatePartner_div_eq_norm_defect_div_sq
    (rho : NontrivialZetaZero) :
    pairedEtaLocalizedGaussianLargeTimeLeadingCoefficient
          (NontrivialZetaZero.conjugatePartner rho) /
        pairedEtaLocalizedGaussianLargeTimeLeadingCoefficient rho =
      (‖pairedEtaLeadingLogGapMomentDefect
            (NontrivialZetaZero.conjugatePartner rho)‖ /
          ‖pairedEtaLeadingLogGapMomentDefect rho‖) ^ 2 := by
  rw [pairedEtaLeadingLogGapMomentDefect_eq_logLaplaceMoment,
    pairedEtaLeadingLogGapMomentDefect_eq_logLaplaceMoment]
  unfold pairedEtaLocalizedGaussianLargeTimeLeadingCoefficient
  simp only [analyticZetaZeroMultiplicity_conjugatePartner,
    Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  have hchoose :
      (((2 * analyticZetaZeroMultiplicity rho).choose
          (analyticZetaZeroMultiplicity rho) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.choose_pos (by omega :
      analyticZetaZeroMultiplicity rho ≤
        2 * analyticZetaZeroMultiplicity rho)).ne'
  have hfactorial :
      ((analyticZetaZeroMultiplicity rho).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.factorial_pos
      (analyticZetaZeroMultiplicity rho)).ne'
  have hmoment :
      ‖pairedEtaLogLaplaceMoment
          (analyticZetaZeroMultiplicity rho) rho.1‖ ≠ 0 := by
    exact norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr
      (pairedEtaLogLaplaceMoment_multiplicity_ne_zero rho)
  field_simp [hchoose, hfactorial, hmoment]

/-- The explicit finite arithmetic upper certificate for the partner-to-
original leading-coefficient ratio. -/
def pairedEtaLeadingCoefficientRatioFiniteUpper
    (rho : NontrivialZetaZero) (theta : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (pairedEtaLeadingLogGapMomentDefectUpper
        (analyticZetaZeroMultiplicity rho) (1 - rho.1.re) /
      pairedEtaLogLaplaceMomentFiniteLower
        (analyticZetaZeroMultiplicity rho) rho.1 theta N) ^ 2

/-- A positive phase-sensitive lower certificate at `rho` makes the finite
arithmetic quotient a valid upper bound for the exact complementary leading-
coefficient ratio. -/
theorem
    pairedEtaLocalizedGaussianLargeTimeLeadingCoefficient_conjugatePartner_div_le_finiteUpper
    (rho : NontrivialZetaZero) {theta : ℝ}
    (htheta : 0 < theta) (hthetaOne : theta < 1) (N : ℕ)
    (hlower : 0 < pairedEtaLogLaplaceMomentFiniteLower
      (analyticZetaZeroMultiplicity rho) rho.1 theta N) :
    pairedEtaLocalizedGaussianLargeTimeLeadingCoefficient
          (NontrivialZetaZero.conjugatePartner rho) /
        pairedEtaLocalizedGaussianLargeTimeLeadingCoefficient rho ≤
      pairedEtaLeadingCoefficientRatioFiniteUpper rho theta N := by
  rw [
    pairedEtaLocalizedGaussianLargeTimeLeadingCoefficient_conjugatePartner_div_eq_norm_defect_div_sq]
  have hlowerLe :
      pairedEtaLogLaplaceMomentFiniteLower
          (analyticZetaZeroMultiplicity rho) rho.1 theta N ≤
        ‖pairedEtaLeadingLogGapMomentDefect rho‖ :=
    pairedEtaLeadingLogGapMomentFiniteLower_le_norm_defect
      rho htheta hthetaOne N
  have hpartnerUpper :
      ‖pairedEtaLeadingLogGapMomentDefect
          (NontrivialZetaZero.conjugatePartner rho)‖ ≤
        pairedEtaLeadingLogGapMomentDefectUpper
          (analyticZetaZeroMultiplicity rho) (1 - rho.1.re) := by
    simpa [NontrivialZetaZero.conjugatePartner_coe] using
      norm_pairedEtaLeadingLogGapMomentDefect_le_upper
        (NontrivialZetaZero.conjugatePartner rho)

/-!
# Adjoining the independent Dirichlet coordinate to the finite-prime field

The intrinsic finite-prime coefficient field lives in the fraction field of arithmetic
functions.  This module adjoins one independent rational coordinate, producing the formal
coefficient field `E_fin(s)`.  Algebraic independence over the finite-prime field survives this
extension: the new coordinate is transcendental over every family of constant arithmetic
fractions, and passage from polynomials to rational functions is algebraic.

The ambient `RatFunc arithmeticFunctionFractionField` is a formal algebraic carrier.  A separate
analytic realization may later send its coordinate to the upper-end variable and its constant
coefficients to meromorphic L-series germs.
-/

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

open Set

noncomputable section

/-- Adding one formal rational coordinate to any algebraically independent family of constants
preserves independence over the polynomial coordinate algebra. -/
theorem algebraicIndependent_ratFuncConstants_over_coordinateAdjoin
    {K F I : Type*} [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F]
    (x : I → F) (hx : AlgebraicIndependent K x) :
    AlgebraicIndependent
      (Algebra.adjoin K
        (Set.range (fun _ : Unit => (RatFunc.X : RatFunc F))))
      (fun i => algebraMap F (RatFunc F) (x i)) := by
  let A := RatFunc F
  let xR : I → A := fun i => algebraMap F A (x i)
  have hxR : AlgebraicIndependent K xR :=
    hx.map' (f := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K F A) (algebraMap F A).injective
  let B : Subalgebra K A := (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K F A).range
  have hle : Algebra.adjoin K (Set.range xR) ≤ B := by
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro y ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x i, rfl⟩
  let e := AlgEquiv.ofInjective (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K F A)
    (algebraMap F A).injective
  let _ : Algebra (Algebra.adjoin K (Set.range xR)) F :=
    (e.symm.toAlgHom.comp (Subalgebra.inclusion hle)).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower (Algebra.adjoin K (Set.range xR)) F A :=
    .of_algebraMap_eq fun y => show _ = (e (e.symm _)).1 by simp
  have htrans : Transcendental (Algebra.adjoin K (Set.range xR))
      (RatFunc.X : A) :=
    (RatFunc.transcendental_X (K := F)).restrictScalars
      (e.symm.injective.comp (Subalgebra.inclusion_injective hle))
  have hopt : AlgebraicIndependent K
      (fun o : Option I => o.elim (RatFunc.X : A) xR) :=
    (hxR.option_iff_transcendental (RatFunc.X : A)).mpr htrans
  have hjoint : AlgebraicIndependent K
      (Sum.elim xR (fun _ : Unit => (RatFunc.X : A))) := by
    let eqv : I ⊕ Unit ≃ Option I :=
      { toFun := fun z => Sum.elim some (fun _ => none) z
        invFun := fun o => o.elim (Sum.inr ()) Sum.inl
        left_inv := by
          intro z
          rcases z with i | u
          · rfl
          · rcases u
            rfl
        right_inv := by
          intro o
          rcases o with _ | i <;> rfl }
    have heq : (Sum.elim xR (fun _ : Unit => (RatFunc.X : A))) =
        (fun z => (fun o : Option I => o.elim (RatFunc.X : A) xR) (eqv z)) := by
      funext z
      rcases z with i | u
      · rfl
      · rcases u
        rfl
    rw [heq]
    exact hopt.comp eqv eqv.injective
  simpa only [xR, A] using (AlgebraicIndependent.sumElim_iff.mp hjoint).2

/-- **The two socle means differ by the von Mangoldt Dirichlet mass.** -/

/-- **Theorem 8.1, equation (GAS.12).**  The symmetrised Kullback–Leibler divergence of the

theorem klDiv_symmetrised_eq_vonMangoldt (σ : EulerSigma) :

/-- **Theorem 8.1 in zeta form.**  The symmetrised relative entropy is `σ·(−ζ′/ζ)(σ)`. -/

/-! ## The two relative entropies -/

theorem ac_tilt_temperature (σ : EulerSigma) :
    classLaw (tiltConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters
      ≪ classLaw (temperatureConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters :=
  classLaw_absolutelyContinuous (temperatureConv σ) (tiltConv σ)

theorem ac_temperature_tilt (σ : EulerSigma) :
    classLaw (temperatureConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters
      ≪ classLaw (tiltConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters :=
  classLaw_absolutelyContinuous (tiltConv σ) (temperatureConv σ)

theorem llr_tilt_ae_tilt (σ : EulerSigma) :
    llr (classLaw (tiltConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters)
        (classLaw (temperatureConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters)
      =ᵐ[classLaw (tiltConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters]
        fun A => Real.log ((densityConst σ).toReal)
          - σ.val * Real.log (((A.socleOrder : ℝ))) :=
  (llr_classLaw_tiltConv σ).filter_mono (ac_tilt_temperature σ).ae_le

theorem integrable_llr_tilt (σ : EulerSigma) :
    Integrable (llr (classLaw (tiltConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters)
        (classLaw (temperatureConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters))
      (classLaw (tiltConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters) := by
  refine Integrable.congr ?_ (llr_tilt_ae_tilt σ).symm
  exact (integrable_const _).sub
    ((integrable_classLaw_logSocle (tiltConv σ) (socleExpectation_tilt_ne_top σ)).const_mul σ.val)

theorem integrable_llr_temperature (σ : EulerSigma) :
    Integrable (llr (classLaw (temperatureConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters)
        (classLaw (tiltConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters))
      (classLaw (temperatureConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters) := by
  refine Integrable.congr ?_
    ((llr_classLaw_temperatureConv σ).filter_mono (ac_temperature_tilt σ).ae_le).symm
  exact (integrable_const _).add
    ((integrable_classLaw_logSocle (temperatureConv σ)
      (socleExpectation_temperature_ne_top σ)).const_mul σ.val)

theorem integral_llr_tilt (σ : EulerSigma) :
    ∫ A, llr (classLaw (tiltConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters)
        (classLaw (temperatureConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters) A
        ∂(classLaw (tiltConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters)
      = Real.log ((densityConst σ).toReal)
        - σ.val * (AbelianZetaParameters.socleExpectation (tiltParameters σ)).toReal := by
  rw [integral_congr_ae (llr_tilt_ae_tilt σ),
    integral_sub (integrable_const _)
      ((integrable_classLaw_logSocle (tiltConv σ)
        (socleExpectation_tilt_ne_top σ)).const_mul σ.val),
    integral_const, integral_const_mul, integral_classLaw_logSocle (tiltConv σ),
    probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
  rfl

theorem integral_llr_temperature (σ : EulerSigma) :
    ∫ A, llr (classLaw (temperatureConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters)
        (classLaw (tiltConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters) A
        ∂(classLaw (temperatureConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters)
      = -Real.log ((densityConst σ).toReal)
        + σ.val * (AbelianZetaParameters.socleExpectation
          (AbelianZetaParameters.temperatureParameters σ.val σ.pos)).toReal := by
  rw [integral_congr_ae
      ((llr_classLaw_temperatureConv σ).filter_mono (ac_temperature_tilt σ).ae_le),
    integral_add (integrable_const _)
      ((integrable_classLaw_logSocle (temperatureConv σ)

    integral_const, integral_const_mul, integral_classLaw_logSocle (temperatureConv σ),
    probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul]
  rfl

/-! ## Theorem 8.1 — the symmetrised relative entropy is the von Mangoldt mass -/

theorem klDiv_tilt (σ : EulerSigma) :
    klDiv (classLaw (tiltConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters)
        (classLaw (temperatureConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters)
      = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log ((densityConst σ).toReal)
          - σ.val * (AbelianZetaParameters.socleExpectation (tiltParameters σ)).toReal) := by
  rw [klDiv_of_ac_of_integrable (ac_tilt_temperature σ) (integrable_llr_tilt σ),
    integral_llr_tilt σ, probReal_univ, probReal_univ]
  congr 1

theorem klDiv_temperature (σ : EulerSigma) :
    klDiv (classLaw (temperatureConv σ).toAbelianZetaParameters)

  n^{−c}·k_b(log n) = n^{−c}·k(log n)·n^{b} = n^{−1/2}·k(log n).
Summing against −ζ'/ζ(c+it) = Σ Λ(n)n^{−c−it} (Mathlib LSeries, 1 < c) with a dominated
tsum/integral swap (domination: ‖paperFT k_b t‖(1+t²) ≤ ‖k_b‖₁+‖k_b''‖₁ from
Zeta23.EF.norm_paperFT_mul_one_add_sq_le × Σ Λ(n)n^{−c} < ∞) gives the prime side.

/-- The test function on vertical lines: H(s) := h((s − 1/2)/i). -/
def Hfn (k : ℝ → ℂ) (s : ℂ) : ℂ := paperFT k ((s - 1/2) / I)

/-- The tilted test function k_b(u) := k(u)·e^{b u}. -/
def tilt (k : ℝ → ℂ) (b : ℝ) : ℝ → ℂ := fun u => k u * (Real.exp (b * u) : ℂ)

theorem tilt_contDiff {k : ℝ → ℂ} (hk : ContDiff ℝ 2 k) (b : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (tilt k b) := by
  refine hk.mul ?_
  have : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (b * u)) := (Real.contDiff_exp.comp
    (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)).of_le le_top
  exact Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp this

theorem tilt_hasCompactSupport {k : ℝ → ℂ} (hk : HasCompactSupport k) (b : ℝ) :
    HasCompactSupport (tilt k b) := by
  refine hk.mul_right

/-- On the line Re s = c: H(c+it) = paperFT (tilt k (c − 1/2)) t. -/
theorem Hfn_line (k : ℝ → ℂ) (c t : ℝ) :
    Hfn k (c + t * I) = paperFT (tilt k (c - 1/2)) t := by
  unfold Hfn tilt paperFT
  refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun u => ?_)
  simp only
  have harg : I * ((↑c + ↑t * I - 1/2) / I) * ↑u = (((c - 1/2) * u : ℝ) : ℂ) + I * ↑t * ↑u := by
    have hI : (I : ℂ) ≠ 0 := I_ne_zero
    field_simp
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [harg, Complex.exp_add, ← Complex.ofReal_exp]
  ring

/-- Tilted inversion: (1/2π)∫ paperFT (tilt k b) t · e^{−i t y} dt = k(y)·e^{b y}. -/
theorem tilted_inversion {k : ℝ → ℂ} (hk : ContDiff ℝ 2 k) (hkc : HasCompactSupport k)
    (b y : ℝ) :
    (1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) * ∫ t : ℝ, paperFT (tilt k b) t * cexp (-I * t * y)
      = k y * (Real.exp (b * y) : ℂ) := by
  have hcont := (tilt_contDiff hk b).continuous
  have hint : Integrable (tilt k b) (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
    hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (tilt_hasCompactSupport hkc b)
  have hF := Zeta23.EF.integrable_fourier_of_contDiff_two (tilt_contDiff hk b)
    (tilt_hasCompactSupport hkc b)
  have h1 := Zeta23.EF.paper_inversion hcont hint hF y
  rw [← h1]
  rfl


/-- Step 1 (pointwise on the line): the integrand is the tsum of tilted-transform × L-series
terms.  −ζ'/ζ = LSeries ↗Λ on Re s > 1 (Mathlib), then distribute paperFT (tilt k b) t. -/
theorem integrand_eq_tsum {k : ℝ → ℂ} {c : ℝ} (hc1 : 1 < c) (t : ℝ) :
    Hfn k (c + t * I) * (-logDeriv riemannZeta (c + t * I))
      = ∑' n : ℕ, paperFT (tilt k (c - 1/2)) t * LSeries.term (fun n => (Λ n : ℂ)) (c + t * I) n := by
  have hre : 1 < ((c : ℂ) + t * I).re := by
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    simpa using hc1
  have h1 : -logDeriv riemannZeta ((c : ℂ) + t * I) = LSeries (fun n => (Λ n : ℂ)) ((c:ℂ) + t * I) := by
    have h2 := ArithmeticFunction.LSeries_vonMangoldt_eq_deriv_riemannZeta_div hre
    rw [logDeriv, Pi.div_apply, h2]
    ring
  rw [Hfn_line, h1, LSeries, ← tsum_mul_left]

/-- Step 2 (per-n line integral): (1/2π)∫ paperFT(tilt k b) t · term_n(c+it) dt
  = Λ(n) n^{−1/2} k(log n). -/
theorem per_n_line_integral {k : ℝ → ℂ} (hk : ContDiff ℝ 2 k) (hkc : HasCompactSupport k)
    {c : ℝ} (hc1 : 1 < c) (n : ℕ) :
    (1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) * ∫ t : ℝ,
        paperFT (tilt k (c - 1/2)) t * LSeries.term (fun n => (Λ n : ℂ)) (c + t * I) n
      = ((Λ n / Real.sqrt n : ℝ) : ℂ) * k (Real.log n) := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · simp [LSeries.term]
  · have hn1 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hn0 : (0:ℝ) < (n:ℝ) := by linarith
    have hnC : (n:ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'
    have hterm : ∀ t : ℝ, LSeries.term (fun n => (Λ n : ℂ)) (c + t * I) n

ilted_inversion hk hkc (c - 1/2) (Real.log n)]
    have hexp : Real.exp ((c - 1/2) * Real.log n) = (n:ℝ) ^ (c - 1/2) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hn0]
      ring_nf
    have hpow : ((n:ℝ) ^ (-c) : ℝ) * ((n:ℝ) ^ (c - 1/2) : ℝ) = ((n:ℝ) ^ (-(1/2) : ℝ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hn0]
      congr 1
      ring
    have hsqrt : ((n:ℝ) ^ (-(1/2) : ℝ) : ℝ) = 1 / Real.sqrt n := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hn0.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
      exact (one_div _).symm
    calc (χ n : ℂ) * ((Λ n : ℝ) : ℂ) * (((n:ℝ) ^ (-c) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        * (k (Real.log n) * ((Real.exp ((c - 1/2) * Real.log n) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        = (χ n : ℂ) * (((Λ n * ((n:ℝ) ^ (-c) * (n:ℝ) ^ (c - 1/2)) : ℝ)) : ℂ)
          * k (Real.log n) := by
          rw [hexp]
          push_cast
          ring
      _ = (χ n : ℂ) * ((Λ n / Real.sqrt n : ℝ) : ℂ) * k (Real.log n) := by
          rw [hpow, hsqrt, mul_one_div]

/-- Twisted tsum/integral swap (domination: ‖χ(n)‖ ≤ 1 reduces to the ζ-side majorant). -/
theorem line_integral_swap_chi (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {k : ℝ → ℂ} (hk : ContDiff ℝ 2 k)
    (hkc : HasCompactSupport k) {c : ℝ} (hc1 : 1 < c) :
    ∫ t : ℝ, (∑' n : ℕ, paperFT (tilt k (c - 1/2)) t
        * LSeries.term (fun n => (χ n : ℂ) * (Λ n : ℂ)) (((c:ℝ):ℂ) + t * I) n)
      = ∑' n : ℕ, ∫ t : ℝ, paperFT (tilt k (c - 1/2)) t
        * LSeries.term (fun n => (χ n : ℂ) * (Λ n : ℂ)) (((c:ℝ):ℂ) + t * I) n := by
  have hkb2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 (tilt k (c - 1/2)) := tilt_contDiff hk _
  have hkbc : HasCompactSupport (tilt k (c - 1/2)) := tilt_hasCompactSupport hkc _
  have hFkb := Zeta23.EF.integrable_fourier_of_contDiff_two hkb2 hkbc
  have hpfi : Integrable (fun t : ℝ => paperFT (tilt k (c - 1/2)) t) :=
    Zeta23.EF.integrable_paperFT_ofReal hFkb
  have hre : ∀ t : ℝ, ((((c:ℝ)):ℂ) + t * I).re = c := by
    intro t
    simp
  have hnormle : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (χ n : ℂ) * (Λ n : ℂ))
      (((c:ℝ):ℂ) + t * I) n‖ ≤ if n = 0 then (0:ℝ) else (Λ n : ℝ) * ((n:ℝ) ^ (-c)) := by
    intro n t
    rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
    · simp [LSeries.term_zero]
    · rw [LSeries.term_of_ne_zero hn, norm_div, norm_mul,
        Complex.norm_natCast_cpow_of_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn), hre, if_neg hn,
        Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg,
        Real.rpow_neg (Nat.cast_nonneg n), div_eq_mul_inv]
      have hχb := DirichletCharacter.norm_le_one χ (n : ZMod q)
      have hrp : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((n:ℝ) ^ (c:ℝ))⁻¹ := by positivity
      have hΛ0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Λ n := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg
      calc ‖(χ (n : ZMod q) : ℂ)‖ * Λ n * ((n:ℝ) ^ (c:ℝ))⁻¹
          ≤ 1 * Λ n * ((n:ℝ) ^ (c:ℝ))⁻¹ := by gcongr
        _ = Λ n * ((n:ℝ) ^ (c:ℝ))⁻¹ := by ring
  have hcont : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (fun t : ℝ =>
      LSeries.term (fun n => (χ n : ℂ) * (Λ n : ℂ)) (((c:ℝ):ℂ) + t * I) n) := by
    intro n
    rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
    · simpa [LSeries.term_zero] using continuous_const
    · simp only [LSeries.term_of_ne_zero hn]
      refine continuous_const.div ?_ (fun t => ?_)
      · refine Continuous.const_cpow (by fun_prop) (Or.inl ?_)
        exact_mod_cast hn
      · exact cpow_ne_zero_iff.mpr (Or.inl (by exact_mod_cast hn))

      * LSeries.term (fun n => (χ n : ℂ) * (Λ n : ℂ)) (((c:ℝ):ℂ) + t * I) n) := by
    intro n
    refine hpfi.mul_bdd (c := if n = 0 then (0:ℝ) else (Λ n : ℝ) * ((n:ℝ) ^ (-c)))
      (hcont n).aestronglyMeasurable ?_

    have hs : LSeriesSummable (fun n => (Λ n : ℂ)) (c : ℂ) :=
      ArithmeticFunction.LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt (by simpa using hc1)
    have hns : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖LSeries.term (fun n => (Λ n : ℂ)) (c : ℂ) n‖) :=
      summable_norm_iff.mpr hs

    · simp [LSeries.term_zero]
    · rw [LSeries.term_of_ne_zero hn, norm_div,
        Complex.norm_natCast_cpow_of_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn), Complex.ofReal_re,
        if_neg hn, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg,
        Real.rpow_neg (Nat.cast_nonneg n), div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hsum : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ∫ t : ℝ, ‖paperFT (tilt k (c - 1/2)) t
      * LSeries.term (fun n => (χ n : ℂ) * (Λ n : ℂ)) (((c:ℝ):ℂ) + t * I) n‖) := by
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => integral_nonneg fun t => norm_nonneg _)
      (fun n => ?_)

/-!
# The relative entropy of the zeta-Gibbs law against its canonical unit tilt

The socle observable `log|soc A|` has finite mean under both the untilted gas and its canonical
unit tilt, and the two means differ by exactly the von Mangoldt Dirichlet mass.  Since the tilt is
the density `ζ(σ)|soc A|^{−σ}`, the symmetrised Kullback–Leibler divergence of the pair is `σ`
times that mass.
-/

/-! ## Finiteness of the socle expectation -/

theorem log_prime_nonneg (p : Nat.Primes) : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (((p : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
  Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast p.2.one_lt.le)

theorem summable_primes_log_mul_tsum_modeMean (σ : EulerSigma) :
    Summable fun p : Nat.Primes =>
      Real.log (((p : ℕ) : ℝ)) * ∑' j : ℕ, modeMean (eqgQ σ (p : ℕ)) j := by
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun p => ?_) (fun p => ?_)
    (summable_primes_log_mul_ladderBound σ)
  · exact mul_nonneg (log_prime_nonneg p)
      (tsum_nonneg fun j =>
        modeMean_nonneg (eqgQ_pos σ p.2.pos).le (eqgQ_lt_one σ p.2.two_le) j)
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (tsum_modeMean_le (eqgQ_pos σ p.2.pos).le (eqgQ_lt_one σ p.2.two_le)) (log_prime_nonneg p)

/-- **The socle expectation of the untilted gas, in real form.** -/
theorem socleExpectation_temperature_eq_ofReal (σ : EulerSigma) :
    AbelianZetaParameters.socleExpectation
        (AbelianZetaParameters.temperatureParameters σ.val σ.pos)
      = ENNReal.ofReal (∑' p : Nat.Primes,
          Real.log (((p : ℕ) : ℝ)) * ∑' j : ℕ, modeMean (eqgQ σ (p : ℕ)) j) := by
  rw [socleExpectation_temperature σ,
    ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg
      (fun p => mul_nonneg (log_prime_nonneg p)
        (tsum_nonneg fun j =>
          modeMean_nonneg (eqgQ_pos σ p.2.pos).le (eqgQ_lt_one σ p.2.two_le) j))
      (summable_primes_log_mul_tsum_modeMean σ)]
  refine tsum_congr fun p => ?_
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (log_prime_nonneg p),
    tsum_ofReal_modeMean_eq _ (eqgQ_pos σ p.2.pos).le (eqgQ_lt_one σ p.2.two_le)]

theorem socleExpectation_temperature_ne_top (σ : EulerSigma) :
    AbelianZetaParameters.socleExpectation
      (AbelianZetaParameters.temperatureParameters σ.val σ.pos) ≠ ⊤ := by
  rw [socleExpectation_temperature_eq_ofReal σ]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top

theorem socleExpectation_tilt_ne_top (σ : EulerSigma) :
    AbelianZetaParameters.socleExpectation (tiltParameters σ) ≠ ⊤ := by
  refine ne_top_of_le_ne_top (socleExpectation_temperature_ne_top σ) ?_
  rw [socleExpectation_eq_tilt_add_residue σ]
  exact le_self_add

/-! ## The residue as a real Dirichlet mass -/

theorem modeMean_zero_le_ladderBound {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) :
    modeMean q 0 ≤ q / (1 - q) ^ 2 := by
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - q := by linarith
  have hsq : (0 : ℝ) < (1 - q) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hle : (1 - q) ^ 2 ≤ 1 - q := by nlinarith
  have : modeMean q 0 = q / (1 - q) := by
    rw [modeMean]
    norm_num
  rw [this]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hq0 hsq hle

theorem summable_primes_log_mul_modeMean_zero (σ : EulerSigma) :
    Summable fun p : Nat.Primes =>
      Real.log (((p : ℕ) : ℝ)) * modeMean (eqgQ σ (p : ℕ)) 0 := by
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun p => ?_) (fun p => ?_)
    (summable_primes_log_mul_ladderBound σ)
  · exact mul_nonneg (log_prime_nonneg p)
      (modeMean_nonneg (eqgQ_pos σ p.2.pos).le (eqgQ_lt_one σ p.2.two_le) 0)
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (modeMean_zero_le_ladderBound (eqgQ_pos σ p.2.pos).le (eqgQ_lt_one σ p.2.two_le))
      (log_prime_nonneg p)

/-- **The von Mangoldt residue of (GAS.12), in `ℝ≥0∞` form.** -/
theorem residue_eq_ofReal_vonMangoldt (σ : EulerSigma) :
    (∑' p : Nat.Primes, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (((p : ℕ) : ℝ)))
        * ENNReal.ofReal (modeMean (eqgQ σ (p : ℕ)) 0))
      = ENNReal.ofReal (∑' n : ℕ, Λ n * (n : ℝ) ^ (-σ.val)) := by
  rw [← tsum_primes_modeMean_zero σ,
    ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg
      (fun p => mul_nonneg (log_prime_nonneg p)
        (modeMean_nonneg (eqgQ_pos σ p.2.pos).le (eqgQ_lt_one σ p.2.two_le) 0))
      (summable_primes_log_mul_modeMean_zero σ)]
  exact tsum_congr fun p => (ENNReal.ofReal_mul (log_prime_nonneg p)).symm

/-! ## The socle observable is integrable -/

theorem logSocle_nonneg (A : AbelianZetaGroupClass) :
    (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (((A.socleOrder : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
  Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast A.socleOrder_pos)

theorem measurable_logSocle :
    Measurable fun A : AbelianZetaGroupClass => Real.log (((A.socleOrder : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
  fun _ _ => trivial

/-- **The mean socle observable is the socle expectation.** -/
theorem integral_classLaw_logSocle (θ : AbelianZetaConvergentParameters) :
    ∫ A, Real.log (((A.socleOrder : ℕ) : ℝ)) ∂(classLaw θ.toAbelianZetaParameters)

      (fun t : ℝ => ((3 : ℂ) / (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) •
        ((t : ℂ) ^ ((2 : ℕ) : ℂ) • gaussianKernel t)) s :=
    (mellinConvergent_cpow_gaussian 2 (re_add_natCast_two hs)).const_smul _
  have hsub : mellin ((fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) ^ ((4 : ℕ) : ℂ) • gaussianKernel t)
      - fun t : ℝ => ((3 : ℂ) / (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) •
        ((t : ℂ) ^ ((2 : ℕ) : ℂ) • gaussianKernel t)) s
      = mellin (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) ^ ((4 : ℕ) : ℂ) • gaussianKernel t) s
        - mellin (fun t : ℝ => ((3 : ℂ) / (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))) •
            ((t : ℂ) ^ ((2 : ℕ) : ℂ) • gaussianKernel t)) s := (hasMellin_sub hF hG).2
  rw [meyerPoissonTest_ofReal_eq_sub, hsub,
    mellin_cpow_smul, mellin_const_smul, mellin_cpow_smul]
  rw [show ((4 : ℕ) : ℂ) = (4 : ℂ) from by norm_num,

    (hrho : rho.re = 1 / 2)
    (hp : AnalyticAt ℂ p rho) (hpzero : p rho ≠ 0)
    (hfactor : riemannZeta =ᶠ[𝓝 rho]
      fun z : ℂ => (z - rho) ^ (q + 1) * p z)
    (hGanalytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ
      (mellin mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform) rightHalf)
    (hsharp : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      ‖(r : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) *
          mellin mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform (rho + (r : ℂ))‖ ≤
        C * (q.factorial : ℝ) + r ^ (q + 1) * B) :

    (hp : AnalyticAt ℂ p rho) (hpzero : p rho ≠ 0)
    (hfactor : riemannZeta =ᶠ[𝓝 rho]
      fun z : ℂ => (z - rho) ^ (q + 1) * p z)
    (hGanalytic : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ
      (mellin mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform) rightHalf)
    (hsharp : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      ‖(r : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) *
          mellin mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform (rho + (r : ℂ))‖ ≤
        C * (q.factorial : ℝ) + r ^ (q + 1) * B) :
    ‖Complex.Gamma rho / p rho‖ ≤ C * (q.factorial : ℝ)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hray := tendsto_critical_ray rho
  have hrhoOne : rho ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    subst rho
    norm_num at hrho
  have hfactorRay : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      riemannZeta (rho + (r : ℂ)) =
        ((r : ℂ) ^ (q + 1)) * p (rho + (r : ℂ)) := by
    have h := hray.eventually hfactor
    filter_upwards [h] with r hr
    simpa using hr
  have hpRay : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => p (rho + (r : ℂ)))
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (p rho)) := hp.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hray
  have hpRayNe : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, p (rho + (r : ℂ)) ≠ 0 :=
    hpRay.eventually (isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hpzero)
  have hnotOne : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0, rho + (r : ℂ) ≠ 1 :=
    hray.eventually (isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds hrhoOne)
  have hscaledEq : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] 0,
      (r : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) *
          mellin mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform (rho + (r : ℂ)) =
        Complex.Gamma (rho + (r : ℂ)) / p (rho + (r : ℂ)) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hfactorRay, hpRayNe, hnotOne]
      with r hr hfac hpne hsone
    have hright : rho + (r : ℂ) ∈ rightHalf := by
      rw [mem_rightHalf, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, hrho]
      norm_num
      exact hr
    have hcanonical :=
      mellin_mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform_mul_zetaResidueUnit_eq_of_analyticOnNhd
        hGanalytic (rho + (r : ℂ)) hright
    simp only [zetaResidueUnit, Function.update_of_ne hsone] at hcanonical
    have hcancel :
        mellin mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform (rho + (r : ℂ)) *
            riemannZeta (rho + (r : ℂ)) =
          Complex.Gamma (rho + (r : ℂ)) := by
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hsone)
      calc
        (mellin mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform (rho + (r : ℂ)) *
              riemannZeta (rho + (r : ℂ))) *
            (rho + (r : ℂ) - 1) =
            mellin mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform (rho + (r : ℂ)) *
              ((rho + (r : ℂ) - 1) *
                riemannZeta (rho + (r : ℂ))) := by ring
        _ = Complex.Gamma (rho + (r : ℂ)) *
            (rho + (r : ℂ) - 1) := hcanonical
    apply (eq_div_iff hpne).2
    rw [hfac] at hcancel
    calc
      ((r : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) *
          mellin mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform (rho + (r : ℂ))) *
          p (rho + (r : ℂ)) =
          mellin mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform (rho + (r : ℂ)) *
            ((r : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) * p (rho + (r : ℂ))) := by ring
      _ = Complex.Gamma (rho + (r : ℂ)) := hcancel
  have hnotGammaPole : ∀ m : ℕ, rho ≠ -(m : ℂ) := by
    intro m h
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
    simp only [neg_re, natCast_re] at hre
    rw [hrho] at hre
    have hm : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
    linarith
  have hgammaRay : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => Complex.Gamma (rho + (r : ℂ)))
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (Complex.Gamma rho)) :=
    (Complex.continuousAt_Gamma rho hnotGammaPole).tendsto.comp hray
  have hscaled : Tendsto
      (fun r : ℝ => (r : ℂ) ^ (q + 1) *
        mellin mobiusDiscreteLaplaceTransform (rho + (r : ℂ)))
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (Complex.Gamma rho / p rho)) := by
    refine (hgammaRay.div hpRay hpzero).congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [hscaledEq] with r hr
    exact hr.symm
  have hrZero : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => r) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_id.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hrPowZero : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => r ^ (q + 1))
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := hrZero.pow (q + 1)
    simpa [zero_pow (by omega : q + 1 ≠ 0)] using h
  have hupper : Tendsto
      (fun r : ℝ => C * (q.factorial : ℝ) + r ^ (q + 1) * B)
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (C * (q.factorial : ℝ))) := by
    simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.add (hrPowZero.mul tendsto_const_nhds)
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto hscaled.norm hupper hsharp

# Theta Mellin-six holonomy forms the integral--nuclear history

- **ID:** ULF-TM6H-001
- **Stage:** 2-fully-proven
- **Type:** unconditional pre-divisor four-organ formation theorem
- **Parents:** ULF-DHNJ-001, ULF-PPTI-001;
  `EulerHedenmalmGammaStokesTransgression`,
  `EulerPrimitivePolarizedHodgeBetaTransgression`
- **Surviving RH edge:** the source history of the prime-mixed defect is now literally theta-formed;
  the remaining edge is a same-boundary theorem carrying this formed defect into completed Xi
  relative energy without supplying a divisor or restating RH.

## 1. Higher-law interpretation

The history marginal of the prime-mixed integral--nuclear defect is not an auxiliary Kummer law.
It is the discrete transgression of one literal theta atom.  Remove the universal Euler pole
polynomial from the atom's Mellin response, move six units in Mellin degree, and normalize at the
first admissible grade.  The result is exactly every survival tail of `mathsf T`; its adjacent
loss is exactly every emitted nuclear weight.

```text
literal theta first atom
  -- Mellin transform --> Euler pole polynomial * Gamma_R
  -- strip pole polynomial --> Gamma_R
  -- normalized shift by six --> Hodge survival m_n
  -- adjacent transgression --> nuclear flux w_n
  -- tensor prime Poisson Gram --> mathsf T.
```

No zero, Xi divisor, ordinate, fitted clock, or RH premise occurs.  The shift by six is not a
chosen scale: it is the composition of the two source-forced `3/2` Hellinger sewings in
ULF-DHNJ-001, expressed in the doubled Mellin coordinate of `Gamma_R`.

## 2. Corpus audit before formulation

Lean-corpus searches for `theta cusp source Mellin transform first atom Gamma half density`,
`Hodge column beta history tail m_n gamma product recurrence`, `Gamma six theta first atom
history tail normalized Mellin holonomy universal polynomial anomaly`, and `thetaCuspSeed
archFactor normalized Hodge history` found:

- `mellin_thetaCuspSeed_eq_archFactor`: the literal first theta atom has Mellin transform
  `A(s)=s(s-1)Gamma_R(s)/2` on `Re(s)>0`;
- `eulerPrimitiveBoundaryHodgeBetaColumn_eq_gammaRatio`: the forced odd-Hodge response is
  `h(a)=-Gamma(a+1/2)Gamma(3/2)/Gamma(a+2)`;
- `eulerPrimitiveBoundaryHodgeBetaColumn_add_one`: its coface ratio is
  `(a+1/2)/(a+2)`;
- ULF-DHNJ-001: `m_n=h(n+1)h(n+5/2)/(h(1)h(5/2))`;
- ULF-PPTI-001: the prime--history operator is `mathsf T=Phi tensor A_d`, where
  `Phi=diag(w_n)`, `w_n=m_n-m_(n+1)`, and `A_d` is the coefficient-faithful prime Cauchy cube.

No checked theorem identifies `m_n` with a normalized Mellin shift of the literal theta atom or
reconstructs `mathsf T` from that shift.

## 3. Pole-stripped theta response

Let `theta_1(t)=thetaCuspSeed(t)` be the literal first theta atom and, for real `s>1`, put

```text
A(s)=integral_(0,infinity) t^(s-1) theta_1(t) dt,
G_theta(s)=2 A(s)/(s(s-1)).                          (TM6H.1)
```

Corpus theorem `mellin_thetaCuspSeed_eq_archFactor` gives

```text
A(s)=s(s-1) Gamma_R(s)/2,
G_theta(s)=Gamma_R(s).                               (TM6H.2)
```

This stripping is forced.  It removes exactly the universal polynomial which cancels the Euler
poles in the completed Xi carrier; no scalar function remains to choose.  Restriction to `s>1`
keeps all divisions source-side and nonzero.

Define the normalized Mellin-six holonomy

```text
H_n = [G_theta(2n+3)/G_theta(2n+9)]
      /[G_theta(3)/G_theta(9)].                      (TM6H.3)
```

## 4. Exact theta-to-history theorem

**Theorem TM6H-A (theta formation of Hodge history).**  For every `n>=0`,

```text
H_n = 105/[(2n+3)(2n+5)(2n+7)] = m_n.               (TM6H.4)
```

Consequently

```text
H_0=1,
H_n-H_(n+1)=w_n,
sum_(k>=n) (H_k-H_(k+1))=H_n.                        (TM6H.5)
```

**Proof.**  Deligne's real Gamma factor obeys

```text
Gamma_R(s+2)=s/(2 pi) Gamma_R(s).
```

Three iterations give

```text
Gamma_R(s)/Gamma_R(s+6)
 =8 pi^3/[s(s+2)(s+4)].                              (TM6H.6)
```

Insert `s=2n+3`, divide by the same formula at `s=3`, and use `(TM6H.2)`:

```text
H_n
 =[8pi^3/((2n+3)(2n+5)(2n+7))]/[8pi^3/(3*5*7)]
 =105/[(2n+3)(2n+5)(2n+7)].
```

This is `PrimeHodgeHistory.m n`.  Equations `(TM6H.5)` are the definition of `w_n` and the
already proved positive telescope. QED.

## 5. Why the double-Hodge product collapses to one theta holonomy

The Hodge response can itself be written in the pole-stripped theta coordinate:

```text
h(a)=-(1/(2pi)) G_theta(2a+1)/G_theta(2a+4).         (TM6H.7)
```

Indeed `G_theta=Gamma_R`, and the definition of `Gamma_R` turns the right side into
`-Gamma(a+1/2)Gamma(3/2)/Gamma(a+2)`.

At the two forced grades from ULF-DHNJ-001, the middle response cancels:

```text
h(n+1)h(n+5/2)

   [G_theta(2n+3)/G_theta(2n+6)]

```

# Thue--Morse exact order-two growth

- **ID:** thue-morse-exact-order
- **Stage:** 3-formalized
- **Type:** THEOREM (Lean), `[BRIDGE]`
- **Source:** `../../2-fully-proven/not_new_scientific_knowledge/thue-morse-entire-dirichlet-order-two.md`
- **Lean:** `formal/GaloisForLFunctions/RHTower/ThueMorseExactOrder.lean`
- **Statement:** The entire continuation of the shifted signed Thue--Morse Dirichlet series has
  matching unconditional upper and lower quadratic growth with leading coefficient `(log 2)/2`.

## Goal

Formalize the paper's exact order-two theorem without assuming a Hadamard-order or asymptotic
Prop. Both the Mellin and reciprocal-Gamma growth bounds are constructed from concrete estimates.

## Gates

- [x] 0 → 1  in-progress: the positive-tail, saddle-window, and Gamma-recurrence route is explicit.
- [x] 1 → 2  fully-proven: the paper proof supplies the two-sided radial argument.
- [x] 2 → 3  formalized: targeted build and axiom audit pass.
- [ ] 3 → 4  theorem certificate complete; publication integration remains editorial.

## Approach

1. Prove the infinite radial product is strictly positive and define its fixed positive unit-radius
   tail constant.
2. Split the product at the unique dyadic bracket for `x`; bound initial factors below by half their
   linear terms and the omitted tail below by the fixed constant.
3. Put `x=exp(-y)` and complete the quadratic to obtain the sharp radial lower law.
4. On the negative real Mellin axis, integrate over a unit interval around the Laplace saddle.
5. Define `thueMorseEntireDirichlet = Gamma⁻¹ · mellin`, prove it is entire and agrees with the
   shifted `LSeries` on `Re s>1`, then use the Gamma recurrence to retain a fixed positive lower
   factor at negative half-integers.
6. Split the Mellin integral at `x=1`; use the exact binary-prefix constant below `1` and a Gamma

# Exact Mellin--Plancherel line bridge for the Möbius--Laplace source

- **ID:** `mobius-laplace-mellin-plancherel-line-bridge`

## Statement

For `f : R -> C`, define its logarithmic Mellin-line source

```text
g_sigma(u) = exp(-sigma u) f(exp(-u)).                         (MP1)
```

Mathlib's Mellin and Fourier normalizations satisfy the pointwise identity

```text
M f(sigma+i y) = Fourier(g_sigma)(y/(2 pi)).                  (MP2)
```

If `g_sigma` belongs to `L1(R) ∩ L2(R)`, then

```text
integral_R |M f(sigma+i y)|^2 dy
  = 2 pi integral_R |g_sigma(u)|^2 du.                        (MP3)
```

Specializing `f=Phi`, the discrete Möbius Laplace transform, gives the exact infinite-aperture
Mellin--Plancherel connector required by the Gamma--Hankel frontier.

## Proof

Equation `(MP2)` is Mellin's logarithmic change of variables with the explicit `2*pi` Fourier
frequency normalization. For `(MP3)`, turn the `L2` source into an `Lp` element. Its unitary
Fourier transform agrees almost everywhere with the classical `L1` Fourier integral by the
existing tempered-distribution bridge. Plancherel preserves the squared norm. Finally,
`y=2*pi*xi` contributes the factor `2*pi`.

No continuity, pointwise decay, zeta zero, or RH premise is used.

Its Mellin transform is, for `Re z>0`,

/-!
# Xi endpoint universality of the inverse-tilted prime–Gamma source

The inverse-tilted finite dyadic prime source reconstructs the canonical continued prime–Gamma
trace at every regular centered point.  The canonical trace independently realizes the completed
Xi logarithmic curvature along a cofinal approach to the upper completion endpoint.  Their common
carrier identifies the concrete finite-prime source pointwise along that approach and transports
the endpoint limit to it.
-/

open Complex Filter Topology

namespace RHTower

noncomputable section

/-- Normalized inverse-tilted dyadic prime/Gamma source. -/
def normalizedInverseTiltedPrimeGammaSource (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -inverseTiltedPrimeGammaSourceTrace z / z

/-- At every point of the explicit endpoint approach, the normalized inverse-tilted source is
exactly the canonical normalized continued prime–Gamma source. -/
theorem normalizedInverseTiltedPrimeGammaSource_xiEndpointApproach_eq (n : ℕ) :
    normalizedInverseTiltedPrimeGammaSource (xiEndpointApproach n) =
      normalizedContinuedPrimeArchSource (xiEndpointApproach n) := by
  let ε : ℝ := 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 3)
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 3 := by linarith
  have hεpos : 0 < ε := by positivity
  have hεhalf : ε < 1 / 2 := by
    dsimp [ε]
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hden]
    nlinarith
  have hεone : ε < 1 := lt_trans hεhalf (by norm_num)
  have hεC : xiEndpointEpsilon n = (ε : ℂ) := by
    simp [xiEndpointEpsilon, ε]
  have hs : 1 / 2 + xiEndpointApproach n * I = (ε : ℂ) := by
    rw [xiEndpointApproach, hεC]
    rw [mul_assoc, Complex.I_mul_I, mul_neg, mul_one]
    ring
  have hspos : 0 < (1 / 2 + xiEndpointApproach n * I).re := by
    rw [hs]
    simpa using hεpos
  have hs1 : 1 / 2 + xiEndpointApproach n * I ≠ 1 := by
    rw [hs]
    exact_mod_cast ne_of_lt hεone
  have hzeta : riemannZeta (1 / 2 + xiEndpointApproach n * I) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hs]
    exact riemannZeta_real_strip_ne_zero hεpos hεone
  rw [normalizedInverseTiltedPrimeGammaSource,
    normalizedContinuedPrimeArchSource,
    inverseTiltedPrimeGammaSourceTrace_eq_continuedPrimeArchSourceRelativeTrace
      hspos hs1 hzeta]

/-- **Xi-endpoint inverse-tilted prime–Gamma source universality law.**  The concrete normalized
inverse-tilted finite-prime source equals the completed Xi logarithmic curvature at every cofinal
approach point and converges to its exact endpoint value. -/
theorem inverseTiltedPrimeGammaSource_endpointUniversality :
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      normalizedInverseTiltedPrimeGammaSource (xiEndpointApproach n) =
        -logDeriv XiC (xiEndpointApproach n) / xiEndpointApproach n) ∧
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ => normalizedInverseTiltedPrimeGammaSource (xiEndpointApproach n))
      atTop (𝓝 (-logDeriv XiC (I / 2) / (I / 2))) := by
  constructor
  · intro n
    exact (normalizedInverseTiltedPrimeGammaSource_xiEndpointApproach_eq n).trans
      (xiEndpointApproach_source_eq n)
  · apply tendsto_normalizedContinuedPrimeArchSource_endpoint.congr'
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n =>
      (normalizedInverseTiltedPrimeGammaSource_xiEndpointApproach_eq n).symm

end

/-!
# The Gibbs variational principle on a probability space

Tilting a probability measure by a potential shifts its log-likelihood ratio by exactly the
potential and the logarithm of the partition function.  Integrating that shift against any
absolutely continuous probability measure exhibits the difference between its relative entropy and
its mean potential as a relative entropy against the tilted measure, hence nonnegative.

The tilted measure attains equality, so the negative logarithm of the partition function is the
least value of relative entropy minus mean potential.  This is the exact duality between source
rarity and action.
-/

open MeasureTheory Real

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

noncomputable section

section Gibbs

variable {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]

/-- The action of a candidate law against a potential: relative entropy minus mean potential. -/
def gibbsAction (q ρ : Measure α) (f : α → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∫ x, llr q ρ x ∂q) - ∫ x, f x ∂q

/-- The log-likelihood ratio against a tilted measure is shifted by the potential and the
logarithm of the partition function. -/
theorem llr_tilted_right (q ρ : Measure α) [SigmaFinite q] [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] {f : α → ℝ}

/-- **Gibbs lower bound.**  Every absolutely continuous candidate law has action at least the
negative logarithm of the partition function. -/
theorem neg_log_integral_exp_le_gibbsAction (ρ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ]

    {q : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure q] (hq : q ≪ ρ)
    (hllr : Integrable (llr q ρ) q) (hfq : Integrable f q)
    (hllr' : Integrable (llr q (ρ.tilted f)) q) :
    -Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (f x) ∂ρ) ≤ gibbsAction q ρ f := by
  have hprob : IsProbabilityMeasure (ρ.tilted f) := isProbabilityMeasure_tilted hf
  have hac : q ≪ ρ.tilted f := hq.trans (absolutelyContinuous_tilted hf)
  have hkl : 0 ≤ ∫ x, llr q (ρ.tilted f) x ∂q := by
    have hbase := InformationTheory.integral_llr_add_sub_measure_univ_nonneg hac hllr'
    have h1 : (ρ.tilted f).real Set.univ = 1 := by simp
    have h2 : q.real Set.univ = 1 := by simp
    rw [h1, h2] at hbase

      (g := fun _ : α => Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (f x) ∂ρ)) (hllr.sub hfq)
      (integrable_const _), integral_sub hllr hfq, integral_const]
    simp

  rw [gibbsAction]
  linarith

logarithm of the partition function. -/
theorem llr_tilted_left_self (ρ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] {f : α → ℝ}

    llr (ρ.tilted f) ρ =ᵐ[ρ.tilted f] fun x => f x - Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (f x) ∂ρ) := by

theorem gibbsAction_tilted (ρ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] {f : α → ℝ}

    gibbsAction (ρ.tilted f) ρ f = -Real.log (∫ x, Real.exp (f x) ∂ρ) := by
